apple.name: SVaultAI: Digital Vault
apple.subtitle: Files, assets and inheritance
apple.promotional_text: Your physical vault, reimagined digitally. Keep important files, memories and logins together, manage supported digital assets, and plan beneficiary access.
apple.description:
Imagine a physical vault in digital form.

SVaultAI is a personal digital vault, not just a password manager. If something you would keep in a physical vault has a digital version, you can keep that file here: private photos and videos, important documents, certificates, personal records and more, within your storage allowance.

FILES, MEMORIES AND LOGINS
Save and organize documents and media. Create or save login details, review a generated login before saving it, and retrieve or delete saved entries. Keep personal notes and memories you want to find again, and remove them when you no longer need them.

ASK YOUR VAULT
Use SVaultAI Chat to find supported saved items and manage them in everyday language. Ask questions, retrieve a memory, find a file or open the right part of your vault. Sensitive wallet keys are not revealed through chat.

DIGITAL ASSETS UNDER YOUR CONTROL
Open Cryptocurrency inside Assets to use non-custodial wallet features for supported cryptocurrencies. Assets also includes Ethereum wallet support for PAX Gold (PAXG) and KMS Labs KAG Silver (KAG): view balances, receive, send and review transaction history where available. These are specific issuer tokens, not an SVaultAI promise of direct ownership or delivery of physical gold or silver.

SVaultAI is not an exchange. There is no in-app buying, selling or trading. Ethereum transfers require ETH for network fees. Issuer terms, country eligibility and transfer restrictions apply; an issuer or unavailable network service can prevent a transfer. Token integrations for property, diamonds, artwork, collectibles, vehicles, inventory and securities remain Coming soon.

INHERITANCE
Prepare beneficiary access through SVaultAI's inheritance settings. Pair beneficiaries and manage the arrangements offered in the app. This is a digital access feature, not a legal will or a substitute for estate advice.

CONCIERGE PASSWORD CHECKS
Opt in to check eligible saved passwords for known exposure using Have I Been Pwned's Pwned Passwords service, alongside on-device weakness and reuse checks. Checks run while your vault is unlocked; the provider receives only a five-character password-hash prefix, not the full password. Review findings, change an affected password on its original service, then update the saved login.

These checks do not prove that an account is safe. Email and background monitoring are not included in this release; private-file exposure scanning and comprehensive dark-web searching are not supported.

YOUR VAULT, YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
SVaultAI uses encryption and PIN-based controls to protect vault data. AI and document features may process content on our servers and with service providers when you use them. Public wallet addresses and blockchain activity are not private vault content. Keep your vault name and PIN safe: SVaultAI cannot recover a forgotten vault name or PIN. Use the same vault on supported web and mobile platforms.

Optional monthly storage plans are billed through your app store and renew automatically unless canceled. Manage or cancel a plan in the store's subscription settings. Available storage and current prices are shown in the app.

Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
apple.whats_new:
We added Assets for supported cryptocurrency wallets, PAX Gold (PAXG) and KMS Labs KAG Silver (KAG) on Ethereum, with balances, receive, send and transaction history. Other token categories are clearly marked Coming soon.

Concierge now offers opt-in password exposure, weakness and reuse checks while the vault is unlocked. Email and background monitoring are not included.

We improved Cryptocurrency navigation, restored a clear Back button and safe spacing on iPhone, and improved the chat balance lookup with clear retry messages when live data is unavailable.

We added store-confirmed update prompts and occasional review requests.
apple.review_notes:
We added Assets support for PAX Gold (PAXG) and KMS Labs KAG Silver (KAG) on Ethereum alongside the existing Cryptocurrency screen. Balances, receive, send and history use the supported wallet/network services. This is a non-custodial wallet integration, not a purchase, exchange, investment or physical-redemption service. The app does not sell tokens or offer yield. ETH is required for Ethereum gas; issuer terms, eligibility, pause and access restrictions apply.

Other token categories are visible as Coming soon and do not offer unsupported balance, receive, send or history actions.

Concierge checks eligible saved passwords only after opt-in while the vault is unlocked. Known exposure checks use the free HIBP Pwned Passwords service with five-character hash-prefix disclosure, plus local weakness and reuse checks. Email and background monitoring are deferred. Private-file exposure and comprehensive dark-web searching are not supported.

The vault name and PIN sign-in, encrypted files/logins/memories, inheritance and store storage subscriptions remain available. Use the separately supplied App Review credentials in the sign-in fields; no production customer's credentials are included in these notes. Review can use zero-balance wallet screens without buying or sending funds.

The new iPhone Cryptocurrency route has a Back button and correct safe-area spacing. Chat balance lookup reports unavailable with Retry rather than a fabricated zero when the live lookup fails.

reviews_and_update_policy.implementation_at_audit: At the initial read-only audit these prompt/update integrations were absent. The release owner is now adding native review requests and store-confirmed update handling. Validate the final implementation on both platforms before using the drafted release notes; this metadata task changes no app behavior.
reviews_and_update_policy.review_prompt_proposal: Use the official StoreKit/Google Play system flow at a natural pause after meaningful engagement, never at first launch or during a transfer, PIN entry or deletion. Choose eligibility by neutral usage, not whether feedback is positive. No rewards, paid reviews, rating prerequisite or 5-star pre-screening. A system request may not show and does not prove a review was submitted/published.
reviews_and_update_policy.manual_review_links: A user-selected Rate SVaultAI item may open the store listing/review URL; do not attach the quota-controlled prompt API to a button that promises a prompt.
reviews_and_update_policy.apple_prompt_limits: Apple controls display; its documented maximum is three occurrences within 365 days. TestFlight cannot verify public review publication.
reviews_and_update_policy.google_prompt_limits: Google uses an undisclosed time-based quota. Completion does not reveal whether a user rated/reviewed. Do not infer a rating or repeatedly prompt after no display.
reviews_and_update_policy.force_update_proposal: A required-update flow must be store-confirmed and downloadable for that installed user, device and country before blocking access. Never gate a pending, ineligible or inaccessible build. Retain failure recovery, data preservation and a rollback switch; metadata alone cannot update an installed app.
reviews_and_update_policy.apple_update_boundary: Automatic updates are user-controlled; App Store delivery is not a remotely forced install. During Apple's phased release anyone can manually download the update. The release owner's in-app required-update handling must remain a store-availability-checked navigation flow, not a promise of remote installation.
reviews_and_update_policy.google_update_boundary: Immediate updates are a client API flow for critical cases, not a Play Console forced-update switch. Require UPDATE_AVAILABLE and isUpdateTypeAllowed for the installed user's device/account. Google requires matching app ID/signing key, Play ownership and a higher eligible versionCode. Existing installed versions without the new client integration cannot be given that flow retroactively.
reviews_and_update_policy.availability_gate: Never raise a hard minimum version while the replacement is pending review, only on a test track, unavailable in that user's country/device, or inaccessible through a partial Play rollout. A staged Play release reaches only selected users. Network/check failure must not delete local credentials, ciphertext or wallet keys. Any future gate needs a rollback switch and offline/unsupported-device policy.
